title: System One models Are Not Better Rerankers
abstract: arXiv:2610.32318v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: System One models, or decision models, answer a question about an input with a calibrated probability instead of generated text. Within weeks of the first release, in September 2026, they were used as rerankers. We test whether the decision fine-tuning behind them makes a better reranker than plain reranker fine-tuning of the same model. For six Qwen backbones from 0.6B to 27B parameters and ten TREC DL and BEIR collections, we compare the untuned model, asked zero-shot, with its decision fine-tunes and its reranker fine-tunes, two of which we train ourselves. In our work, we draw the conclusion that decision fine-tuning never makes the better reranker. From 0.6B to 9B, reranker fine-tuning wins on every backbone by 5 to 29 points nDCG@10, also on zero-shot collections, and at 27B the two tie. translated_title: 系统一模型并非更好的重排序器
translated_abstract: 系统一模型，或称决策模型，通过对输入问题给出一个经过校准的概率而非生成文本来进行回答。在2026年9月首次发布后的几周内，它们便被用作重排序器。我们测试了其背后的决策微调是否比同一模型的普通重排序微调能产生更好的重排序器。针对从0.6B到27B参数的六个Qwen骨干模型以及十个TREC DL和BEIR数据集，我们将零样本提问的未调优模型与其决策微调版本和重排序微调版本进行比较，其中两个微调版本由我们自行训练。在这项工作中，我们得出结论：决策微调永远不会造就更好的重排序器。在0.6B至9B参数范围内，重排序微调在每个骨干模型上均以5到29个点的nDCG@10优势胜出（包括在零样本数据集上），而在27B时两者打平。在9B及以下，决策微调相比直接零样本询问未调优模型没有任何额外收益。此外，我们发现决策模型的校准优势……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过在0.6B至27B参数的六个Qwen骨干模型和十个TREC DL与BEIR数据集上的系统对比，证明决策微调的System One模型并不比普通重排序微调模型是更好的重排序器——重排序微调在0.6B至9B全面胜出5至29个nDCG@10点，27B时两者持平，且9B以下决策微调相比零样本询问未调优模型并无增益。
en_tdlr: Decision fine-tuning never produces a better reranker than plain reranker fine-tuning—across six Qwen backbones and ten TREC DL/BEIR collections, reranker fine-tuning wins by 5–29 nDCG@10 points from 0.6B to 9B and ties at 27B, while below 9B decision fine-tuning adds nothing over zero-shot prompting of the untuned model.
